name: Agentic Evaluation
description:
This data processing flow is designed to evaluate the performance of a language model (LLM) by comparing its outputs against a set of reference answers. The process begins with a dataset containing candidate IDs and reference answers. The flow involves generating LLM outputs and filtering the data to focus on relevant responses. The evaluation step assesses the LLM's performance using metrics such as answer similarity and BERT scores (precision, recall, F1). The final output datasets, `eval_output` and `eval_metrics`, provide detailed insights into the LLM's performance, including execution times, error messages, and various evaluation metrics. These outputs help in understanding the effectiveness and efficiency of the LLM in generating accurate responses.
